summary.text: Chris Jimenez is the Democratic candidate for Texas House District 52 in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging incumbent Republican Caroline Harris.
He is a U.S. Marine Corps veteran and small business owner.

paragraphs.text: Jimenez served in the U.S. Marine Corps from 2002 to 2006 and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Phoenix in 2017.
In a Ballotpedia survey, his campaign said he lives in Williamson County with his family.
The survey describes his priorities as affordability, public education, economic opportunity, public safety, infrastructure and democratic freedoms.
It says he supports expanding access to affordable housing, food security and basic health care, and keeping public education funding in public schools.
